MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #12
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 25

2. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 49

3. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.7
   B. 27.6
   C. 33
   D. 27

4. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 45
   C. 30
   D. 36

5. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. Cannot tell
   C. They are equal
   D. 1/4

6. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x

7. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23
   C. 23.7
   D. 23.6

8. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1

   C. 1
   D. 2

   A. 15.6
   B. 15.7
   C. 15
   D. 21

10. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

11. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. They are equal
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 2/2

12. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 4
   C. 5
   D. 8

13. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 25
   C. 6
   D. 12.5

14. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 42
   C. 90
   D. 21

15. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 66
   B. 17
   C. 22
   D. 34

16. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 33

   C. 22
   D. 28

   D. 25

19. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)

   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 43

20. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 11
   C. 100
   D. 50

21. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 77
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 22

22. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 105
   B. 22
   C. 30
   D. 44

23. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 56

   C. 1
   D. 57

24. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 10
   C. 26
   D. 5
